hook.name: DaemonHook
hook.description: A V4 hook implementing a quadratic bonding-curve token launch with asymmetric fees (1% on buys retained by the reserve, 30% on sells forwarded to the team). All swaps are fully handled by the hook's internal curve; once enough ETH accumulates, the team can graduate by seeding a permanent Uniswap V3 1% pool and burning the LP NFT.
